evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creates a new game; no prerequisite story is required.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators to a game requires a game to exist from PP-001.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starts a new round and creates the initial item; it does not require a prior round or item story.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items requires items to have been added via PP-003 or PP-006.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item requires an existing item list from PP-006 or PP-003.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: This story creates/adds items; it does not depend on another item-creation story.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing requires an item to exist from PP-006 or PP-003.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting requires an item to exist from PP-006 or PP-003.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Showing estimates requires estimates to have been given in a started round/estimation process.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average requires estimates from the active estimation process.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Requires estimator card submissions from an active round.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires an item/round being estimated before a final estimate can be entered.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Requires an earlier estimated item/story and prior estimates.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: This is a bulk item-creation story and does not depend on another item-creation story.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: This is a bulk item-creation method and is self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games requires games to exist from PP-001.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: A transcript requires a game with stories and estimates, created via PP-001 and PP-003.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exported transcript depends on existing game, stories, and estimates.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export depends on existing game, stories, and estimates.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game requires a previously created game.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Creates a new account; no prerequisite account story is required.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requires an account from PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Changing details requires an account from PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account requires an account from PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Local timezone conversion is a standalone display setting.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder requires an existing account from PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with modified Fibonacci sequence or powers of 2
evaluations.rationale: Standalone deck/sequence preference setting.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: This refines/requires the invitation flow from PP-002 and a game from PP-001.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining requires an existing game and invite URL from PP-001 and PP-002.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: The displayed item must be entered or selected via PP-003 or PP-005.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Requires an item list from PP-003 or PP-006.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Requires estimates to be submitted in an active estimation process.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Depends on estimates submitted in a round.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Requires an existing estimate/draw process.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Requires prior estimates for an item from earlier estimation rounds.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Requires estimates for the current round.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer
evaluations.rationale: Creates a standalone timer feature; no prerequisite timer story is required.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Resetting depends on the timer from PP-037 and on an estimation action.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Requires prior rounds, stories, and estimates.

evaluations.evidence: have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Standalone display consistency rule for the card deck.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Requires an existing estimate/draw process.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Standalone display/personalization feature; no clear dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standalone non-functional technical requirement.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Standalone glossary feature.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Standalone technical/performance task; no concrete story-level dependency.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Standalone compatibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Standalone accessibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Standalone performance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Standalone internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Standalone URL design requirement.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages
evaluations.rationale: Standalone error-handling requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storage of results depends on estimation results generated by gameplay stories.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Usage metrics require games and usage data from PP-001.
